gate.title: Sign in to enter Aurora
gate.desc: Aurora is Iterali’s story world. Practise real decisions under pressure. Safe-to-fail, not a test score on you.
gate.hint: Why we ask: sign in saves progress. Practice is not used to monitor you at work.

intro.title: Welcome to Aurora
intro.lead: A narrative investigation where workplace-style decisions shape what survives. Less checkbox training. More confidence under pressure.

mission.title: Entry protocol
mission.narr1: The agent terminal comes online. Logs scroll in the background; a faint neon line pulses in the corner of the screen.
mission.narr2: Secure only writes: "First step: prove you're paying attention to the details." In Aurora, the details you notice are the same cues that matter at work.
mission.puzzleHTML:
A short code snippet flashes on screen:
ACCCESS‑LEVEL: NOVICE_01
Spot the mistake, then enter the correct verification word (letters, numbers and hyphens only).
mission.hintText: Look closely: one letter appears too many times, and not every character is allowed. Use only letters, numbers and hyphens.
mission.statusErrChars: [status] ERROR — only letters, numbers and hyphens allowed.
mission.statusErrWrong: [status] ACCESS DENIED — check the spelling of "ACCESS" and the hyphens.

levels.title: Choose a case
levels.desc: Each Aurora case is safe-to-fail practice inside the story. For teams, Iterali surfaces skill patterns and gaps, not individual mistake replays.
